data.body: [P2] Handle paginated execution input before dispatch. A durable event can have empty initial `Operations` and a `NextMarker`, with the EXECUTION record arriving through pagination; the SDK explicitly covers this in `execution-context.test.ts`. This branch instead treats that event as non-durable and calls `unwrap(event)`, which throws because the durable envelope has no top-level `__example`. Grouped executions with paginated input therefore fail before reaching the SDK. Distinguish durable envelopes from ordinary payloads, retrieve and unwrap the paginated EXECUTION record before delegation, and add an empty-initial-page regression test.
